FolderCopyShared.zhs: 创建一个新文件夹；全部直接子内容仍共享原对象和文件，不递归复制。
FolderCopyShared.en: Create a new folder. All direct contents still share the original objects and files; nested folders are not copied.

FolderCopyLiveContents.zhs: 提交时会重新读取来源内容；复制时未保存内容快照。
FolderCopyLiveContents.en: Source contents are read again when you submit; copying does not save a content snapshot.

FolderCopySourceRequired.zhs: 请先复制一个普通文件夹。此动作不接受剪切或多个来源。
FolderCopySourceRequired.en: First copy one ordinary folder. Cut and multiple sources are not supported.

FolderCopyUnavailable.zhs: 来源内容不可复制或结构无效，本次未创建副本。
FolderCopyUnavailable.en: The source contents cannot be copied or its structure is invalid. No copy was created.

FolderCopyInputExpired.zhs: 来源快照或目标已变化，请重新打开副本输入。
FolderCopyInputExpired.en: The source snapshot or target has changed. Reopen the copy input.

FolderCopied.zhs: 文件夹副本已创建，子内容仍共享原对象。
FolderCopied.en: Folder copy created. Its contents still share the original objects.

CutReady.zhs: 引用已标记待移动，粘贴成功后才会移除源引用。
CutReady.en: References marked for moving. Source references remain until paste succeeds.

PositionUnchanged.zhs: 位置未改变，剪切状态已清空。
PositionUnchanged.en: The location is unchanged. The cut clipboard was cleared.

ConfirmRemoveReferences.zhs: 仅从当前文件夹移除所选引用，保留对象及文件，确定继续？
ConfirmRemoveReferences.en: Remove the selected references from this folder only, keeping objects and files?

Copied.zhs: 已复制引用，可在其他文件夹粘贴。
Copied.en: References copied. You can paste them into another folder.

ClipboardUnavailable.zhs: 请先从当前页或树节点复制或剪切合法引用。
ClipboardUnavailable.en: First copy or cut valid references from this page or a tree node.

ClipboardBusy.zhs: 复制、剪切或粘贴正在处理，请等待结果。
ClipboardBusy.en: Copy, cut or paste is being processed. Wait for the result.

ClipboardOutcomeUnknown.zhs: 本次粘贴结果未知，请核对源和目标内容。清空剪贴板或重新选择后才能再次粘贴。
ClipboardOutcomeUnknown.en: The paste outcome is unknown. Check source and target contents, then clear the clipboard or select fresh references before pasting again.

InvalidClipboardInput.zhs: 复制粘贴请求无效，请重新选择来源。
InvalidClipboardInput.en: The copy or paste request is invalid. Select the source again.

ObjectCopyDenied.zhs: 没有复制所选对象引用的权限。
ObjectCopyDenied.en: You do not have permission to copy the selected object references.

RootOnlyFolders.zhs: 空间根仅接收文件夹，请选择普通文件夹放置零组件或图文档。
RootOnlyFolders.en: Space roots accept folders only. Select an ordinary folder for parts or documents.

InvalidTreeOrderInput.zhs: 树排序请求无效，请在正常树中选择一个普通文件夹。
InvalidTreeOrderInput.en: Select one ordinary folder in the normal tree to reorder.

TreeOrderUnavailable.zhs: 文件夹次序尚未正确初始化，请联系管理员。
TreeOrderUnavailable.en: Folder order is not initialized correctly. Contact an administrator.

TreeOrderExhausted.zhs: 内部文件夹次序已耗尽，本次追加未写入，请联系管理员。
TreeOrderExhausted.en: Internal folder order values are exhausted. Nothing was appended. Contact an administrator.

TreeOrderFirst.zhs: 已是第一个可读文件夹。
TreeOrderFirst.en: This is the first readable folder.

TreeOrderLast.zhs: 已是最后一个可读文件夹。
TreeOrderLast.en: This is the last readable folder.

ConfirmDeleteObjects.zhs: 确定删除所选对象及其在所有文件夹中的引用？此操作不可撤销，非空文件夹不能删除。
ConfirmDeleteObjects.en: Delete the selected objects and all their folder references? This cannot be undone. Non-empty folders cannot be deleted.

FolderNotEmpty.zhs: 文件夹非空，请先清空内容后再删除。本次删除未执行。
FolderNotEmpty.en: Empty the folder before deleting it. No objects were deleted.

RootMutationForbidden.zhs: 空间根文件夹不能编辑或删除。
RootMutationForbidden.en: Space root folders cannot be edited or deleted.

ObjectWriteDenied.zhs: 没有编辑或删除所选对象的权限。
ObjectWriteDenied.en: You do not have permission to edit or delete the selected object.

InvalidSelection.zhs: 请在当前页选择 1 至 100 个不同对象。
InvalidSelection.en: Select 1 to 100 distinct objects on the current page.

InvalidEditInput.zhs: 对象操作请求无效，请刷新后重试。
InvalidEditInput.en: The object request is invalid. Refresh and try again.

ConfirmRemoveReference.zhs: 仅从当前文件夹移除这条引用，保留对象及文件，确定继续？
ConfirmRemoveReference.en: Remove this reference from the current folder only, keeping the object and files?

PublicUnavailable.zhs: 公共空间尚未初始化，请联系管理员。
PublicUnavailable.en: Public space is not initialized. Contact an administrator.

PersonalUnavailable.zhs: 个人空间尚未初始化或不可读取，请重试或联系管理员。
PersonalUnavailable.en: Personal space is not initialized or cannot be read. Retry or contact an administrator.

SearchDisabled.zhs: 工作空间未启用树搜索。

SubjectInputForbidden.zhs: 个人空间命令不接受客户端主体。
SubjectInputForbidden.en: The personal space command does not accept a client-provided subject.

DescriptionTooLong.zhs: 说明必须是文本，且不能超过 500 个字符。
DescriptionTooLong.en: Description must be text and cannot exceed 500 characters.

InvalidName.zhs: 文件夹名称不能为空，且不能超过 256 个字符。
InvalidName.en: Folder name is required and cannot exceed 256 characters.

SiblingNameConflict.zhs: 当前文件夹中已有同名子文件夹，请使用其他名称。
SiblingNameConflict.en: A child folder with this name already exists. Choose another name.

DuplicateReference.zhs: 当前文件夹中已存在该对象的引用。
DuplicateReference.en: This object is already referenced by the current folder.

CycleForbidden.zhs: 该引用会形成文件夹循环，请选择其他文件夹。
CycleForbidden.en: This reference would create a folder cycle. Choose another folder.

RootReferenceForbidden.zhs: 空间根文件夹不能添加为引用。
RootReferenceForbidden.en: A space root folder cannot be added as a reference.

ParentWriteDenied.zhs: 没有编辑当前文件夹内容的权限。
ParentWriteDenied.en: You do not have permission to edit the contents of this folder.

FolderCreateDenied.zhs: 没有创建文件夹的权限。
FolderCreateDenied.en: You do not have permission to create a folder.

CandidateReadDenied.zhs: 没有读取此对象类型的权限，请选择其他类型或联系管理员。
CandidateReadDenied.en: You do not have permission to read this object type. Choose another type or contact an administrator.

TargetUnavailable.zhs: 所选对象不可用或不可读取，请重新选择。
TargetUnavailable.en: The selected object is unavailable or cannot be read. Select another object.

ReferenceUnavailable.zhs: 该引用不可用或不可读取，请刷新后重试。
ReferenceUnavailable.en: This reference is unavailable or cannot be read. Refresh and try again.

PositionUnavailable.zhs: 当前位置已失效或无法访问，请刷新后重试。
PositionUnavailable.en: This location is no longer valid or cannot be accessed. Refresh and try again.

InvalidEndpoint.zhs: 所选对象类型或标识无效，请重新选择。
InvalidEndpoint.en: The selected object type or identifier is invalid. Select another object.

ServerFieldForbidden.zhs: 请求包含由服务端维护的字段，请刷新后重试。
ServerFieldForbidden.en: The request contains fields maintained by the server. Refresh and try again.

InvalidPosition.zhs: 工作空间位置请求无效，请刷新后重试。
InvalidPosition.en: The workspace location request is invalid. Refresh and try again.

InvalidCandidateQuery.zhs: 候选查询参数无效，请重新打开选择窗口。
InvalidCandidateQuery.en: The candidate query parameters are invalid. Reopen the selection dialog.

InvalidCreateInput.zhs: 新建文件夹的请求无效，请刷新后重试。
InvalidCreateInput.en: The create-folder request is invalid. Refresh and try again.

InvalidDetailQuery.zhs: 属性查询参数无效，请重新打开属性。
InvalidDetailQuery.en: The property query parameters are invalid. Reopen the properties.

InvalidReferenceInput.zhs: 引用操作的请求无效，请刷新后重试。
InvalidReferenceInput.en: The reference request is invalid. Refresh and try again.

InvalidPage.zhs: 请求的页码无效，请重新查询。
InvalidPage.en: The requested page is invalid. Run the query again.

SubjectRequired.zhs: 请登录后再执行工作空间操作。
SubjectRequired.en: Sign in before using workspace operations.

UnsupportedQueryDirection.zhs: 此工作空间查询方向不受支持。
UnsupportedQueryDirection.en: This workspace query direction is not supported.
